abstract: Synchronous bilateral testicular tumors of different pathological types in children are extremely rare. Preoperative ultrasound examination is crucial for selecting the optimal treatment strategy. We reported the ultrasound findings and differential diagnosis of a pediatric case involving a left-sided testicular yolk sac tumor and a right-sided teratoma, aiming to enhance understanding of this rare condition and these two types of testicular tumors.
abstract_ja: 病理型の異なる小児の両側同時性精巣腫瘍は極めて稀です。術前の超音波検査は、最適な治療戦略の選択に重要です。左精巣の卵黄嚢腫瘍と右精巣の奇形腫を有する小児症例の超音波所見と鑑別診断を報告し、この稀な病態と、これら2種類の精巣腫瘍の理解を深めることを目的とします。
